description: Fork of exp489/490 (MatmulMultiHeadLut, AdamW=unembedder). gate_mode=layernorm: replace the rational gate entirely with LayerNorm over the K=2^NAP match-scores ts (zero-mean/unit-std + learnable affine gamma,beta[K], identity init), then out = LN(ts) @ W. No T_sel/temperature. Removes common-mode AND normalizes scale; affine kept (decoupled fast knob for convergence, expressivity-redundant w/ W but optimization-useful, like transformer LN). Tests whether a normalized linear projection of match-features beats the bounded rational gates (exp489 unit +0.23, exp490 signed +0.11 vs exp475 1.4962).
